files.author: Ian Poellet
files.caption:
The historic Andrew Young House, built ca. 1875, located at 3720 Duane Street in Astoria, Oregon, United States, is listed on the US National Register of Historic Places.





This is an image of a place or building that is listed on the National Register of Historic Places in the United States of America. Its reference number is 86001391 (Wikidata).
